_comment: Dev/demo NON-SECRET parameters only. postgresAdminPassword is @secure() and is supplied at deploy time from a GitHub Actions secret / Azure Pipelines secret variable (PGADMIN_PASSWORD) via -p postgresAdminPassword=... — NEVER committed here. Image tags default to a public placeholder and are overridden by CD with the real ACR image (todo-api:<sha> / todo-web:<sha>). postgresLocation/postgresServerName are pinned to where Postgres was actually bootstrapped (see infra/README.md and the bootstrap-deploy-fixes commit) — Postgres location and name are immutable after creation, so these must stay fixed for every future deploy (including CD) or it will conflict with the existing server.
